text: Write a Python event-driven simulator for an MoE expert cache with NVMe timing. Include classes for Cache, StorageModel with bandwidth B, per-request overhead t_req, device queue Q_dev, tile_bytes splitting, and telemetry for bytes/token and unhidden I/O. Include deterministic unit tests for byte conservation and Belady optimality on tiny traces. Explain key design choices in comments.

Implement LRU, lifetime LFU, and TinyLFU admission in Python with abstract base classes. Each policy must expose hit/miss/admit/evict with fixed seeds and no hidden global state. Write conformance tests for invariants, edge cases (capacity 0/1, duplicate inserts, deterministic replay). Discuss time and space complexity for a 10240-key namespace.

Write a Rust bare-metal UART driver and block-device abstraction for QEMU virt (PL011 at 0x09000000, virtio-mmio at 0x0a000000). Include read_blocks/write_blocks/capacity_blocks trait, layer-table magic check 0xAE86, expert_offset arithmetic, and boot-time halt on stride mismatch. Provide host-side unit tests for offset math and header validation.

Design a priority software queue feeding an NVMe submission queue: P0 exact misses preempt P3 speculative fetches. Submitted requests cannot be cancelled. Include R1 hold-speculative-in-software-queue, R2 cap speculative bytes in flight to one tile, R3 speculate-only-when-no-exact-pending. Write tests for the bound: always-wrong predictor must add at most cap/B + t_req delay to any exact miss.

Implement EdgeMoE-style co-occurrence predictor: from calibration traces build P(expert at L | sets at L-2, L-1) count tables for 40 layers x 256 experts. Include Laplace smoothing, backoff to 1-layer and popularity baselines, and precision@8/recall@8/12/16 evaluation. Document memory cost of the tables.

Write a utility-based cache partitioner (UCP lookahead, Qureshi & Patt MICRO 2006) over per-layer hit-rate-vs-slots curves. Compare flat global cache vs equal split vs greedy marginal vs lookahead on held-out bytes/token. Plot per-layer curves and flag non-convex cases where greedy fails.

Build a telemetry collector for token latency breakdown: compute, unhidden_io, predictor, lm_head, other; plus bytes read exact vs speculative, wasted bytes, exact-miss added delay, per-layer hits/misses and precision, reuse-distance histograms, queue occupancy, DMA-to-compute wait. Emit CSV/JSON per token with config hash and seed.
